name: etl-runbook
description: Write an ETL operational runbook. Use when the user says "ETL runbook", "pipeline runbook", "data job runbook", "how to operate this ETL", "on-call guide for data pipelines", "what to do when the data job fails", "pipeline troubleshooting guide", "data ops runbook", or needs to document how to operate, monitor, and recover a data pipeline or ETL job - even if they don't explicitly say "runbook".
